units: <cite ref="Sukkah 11a:13">Succ. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>פְּסִיקָתָן זו היא עשייתן</he> cutting the threads apart is the making of them (the show fringes).
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:8">Neg. XI, 8</cite> <he>אפי׳ פ׳ אחת וכ׳</he> even if only one separate thread was on the coil, and he knotted it.—Pl. <he>פְּסִיקוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:8">Ib.</cite> <he>היתה פ׳</he> if the coil consisted of separate threads.
